fusions.name: Slit Glance
fusions.desc: Fires a glance at the first enemy in line, which deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed], its resistance to the elements stripped, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweep of the Gaze
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 5 tiles ahead with your gaze, which deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores resistance. Each target has [Karma] opened against it for 10 seconds: your blows on it land harder and its blows land softer.

fusions.name: Periscope Neck
fusions.desc: Extends your neck from the shell: for 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Nictitating Blink
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
